commands.help:
Usage: lody agent-config [options] [command]

Manage agent configs

Options:
  -h, --help                                 display help for command

Commands:
  list [options]                             List readable agent_config resources
  get [options] <id>                         Read one agent_config by stable id
  show [options] [idOrName]                  Show an agent config; environment values are hidden by default
  refresh-capabilities [options] [idOrName]  Refresh ACP capabilities for an agent config on the current machine
  create [options]                           Create a new agent config
  update [options] [idOrName]                Update an existing agent config
  delete [options] [idOrName]                Delete an agent config
  help [command]                             display help for command

Usage: lody agent-config create [options]

Create a new agent config

Options:
  --agent-type <type>               Agent type identifier
  --workspace <selector>            Target workspace id, slug, or name
  --machine <idOrName>              Machine id or name; defaults to the current
                                    machine
  --name <name>                     Agent config name
  --description <text>              Agent config description
  --env <keyValue>                  Environment variable in KEY=VALUE form;
                                    repeatable (default: [])
  --env-file <path>                 Read environment variables from a file
  --prompt <text>                   Default prompt prefix
  --prompt-file <path|->            Read default prompt prefix from file or
                                    stdin
  --title-config-option <keyValue>  Title generation config option in KEY=VALUE
                                    form; repeatable (default: [])
  --json                            Print JSON output
  --debug                           Enable debug output
  -h, --help                        display help for command

Usage: lody agent-config delete [options] [idOrName]

Delete an agent config

Arguments:
  idOrName                Agent config id or name; falls back to
                          LODY_AGENT_CONFIG_ID

Options:
  --workspace <selector>  Target workspace id, slug, or name
  --json                  Print JSON output
  --debug                 Enable debug output
  -h, --help              display help for command

Usage: lody agent-config get [options] <id>

Read one agent_config by stable id

Options:
  --workspace <selector>  Workspace id, slug or name
  --json                  Print JSON
  --offline               Read cached catalogs; authorization still requires
                          connectivity
  -h, --help              display help for command

Usage: lody agent-config list [options]

List readable agent_config resources

Options:
  --workspace <selector>  Workspace id, slug or name
  --offline               Read cached catalogs; authorization still requires
                          connectivity
  --json                  Print JSON
  --debug                 Enable debug output
  --query <text>          Filter by id, name, description or project path
  --limit <count>         Page size (1-100, default 20)
  --cursor <cursor>       Continue the previous page with the same filters
  --all-pages             Read every page
  --machine <selector>    Machine id or name
  -h, --help              display help for command

Usage: lody agent-config refresh-capabilities [options] [idOrName]

Refresh ACP capabilities for an agent config on the current machine

Arguments:
  idOrName                Agent config id or name; falls back to
                          LODY_AGENT_CONFIG_ID

Options:
  --workspace <selector>  Target workspace id, slug, or name
  --machine <idOrName>    Machine id or name; defaults to the current machine
  --json                  Print JSON output
  --jsonl                 Print JSON Lines output
  --debug                 Enable debug output
  -h, --help              display help for command

Usage: lody agent-config show [options] [idOrName]

Show an agent config; environment values are hidden by default

Arguments:
  idOrName                Agent config id or name; falls back to
                          LODY_AGENT_CONFIG_ID

Options:
  --show-secrets          Include raw environment values in output; may expose
                          credentials
  --workspace <selector>  Target workspace id, slug, or name
  --json                  Print JSON output
  --debug                 Enable debug output
  -h, --help              display help for command

Usage: lody agent-config update [options] [idOrName]

Update an existing agent config

Arguments:
  idOrName                          Agent config id or name; falls back to
                                    LODY_AGENT_CONFIG_ID

Options:
  --workspace <selector>            Target workspace id, slug, or name
  --name <name>                     Updated agent config name
  --description <text>              Updated agent config description; pass
                                    empty to clear
  --env <keyValue>                  Environment variable in KEY=VALUE form;
                                    repeatable (default: [])
  --env-file <path>                 Read environment variables from a file
  --unset-env <key>                 Remove an environment variable; repeatable
                                    (default: [])
  --prompt <text>                   Updated default prompt prefix; pass empty
                                    to clear
  --prompt-file <path|->            Read default prompt prefix from file or
                                    stdin
  --title-config-option <keyValue>  Title generation config option in KEY=VALUE
                                    form; repeatable (default: [])
  --clear-title-generation          Remove title generation settings
  --json                            Print JSON output
  --debug                           Enable debug output
  -h, --help                        display help for command

Usage: lody agent-role [options] [command]

Inspect Agent Roles and propose creations or updates

Options:
  -h, --help                  display help for command

Commands:
  list [options]              List readable agent_role resources
  get [options] <id>          Read one agent_role by stable id
  create [options]            Propose an Agent Role create; save the review
                              card in Lody to apply it
  update [options] <role-id>  Propose an Agent Role update; save the review
                              card in Lody to apply it
  help [command]              display help for command

Usage: lody agent-role create [options]

Propose an Agent Role create; save the review card in Lody to apply it

Options:
  --file <path>               JSON: name, description, promptPrefix, machineId,
                              agentConfigId
  --name <name>               Role name
  --description <text>        Role description; empty string clears it
  --prompt-prefix <text>      Role instructions; empty string clears them
  --session <id>              Conversation for the proposal (defaults to
                              LODY_SESSION_ID)
  -w, --workspace <selector>  Workspace id or slug
  --request-id <id>           Reuse this id when retrying
  --json                      Output JSON
  --debug                     Debug logging
  --machine-id <id>           Machine hosting the Agent config
  --agent-config-id <id>      Agent config to bind
  -h, --help                  display help for command

Usage: lody app [options] [command] [path]

Open the Lody desktop app on a new chat with a local directory selected
(registers it if needed)

Arguments:

Options:
  --workspace <selector>  Target workspace id, slug, or name
  --json                  Print JSON output
  -d, --debug             Enable debug output
  -h, --help              display help for command

Commands:
  reset-cache [options]   Clear the desktop app's local cache on its next
                          launch (use when its window is frozen)

Usage: lody app reset-cache [options]

Clear the desktop app's local cache on its next launch (use when its window is
frozen)

Options:

               recoverable cache
  --cancel     Disarm a reset that has not been applied yet
  --json       Print JSON output
  -d, --debug  Enable debug output
  -h, --help   display help for command

Usage: lody daemon [options] [command]

Usage: lody mcp [options] [command]

Manage workspace MCP servers

Options:
  -h, --help                 display help for command

Commands:
  list [options]             List readable mcp resources
  add [options] <name>       Add a workspace MCP server
  set [options] <server>     Update a workspace MCP server
  remove [options] <server>  Remove a workspace MCP server
  help [command]             display help for command

Usage: lody mcp add [options] <name>

Add a workspace MCP server

Arguments:
  name                         Unique server name

Options:
  --workspace <selector>       Target workspace id, slug, or name
  --json                       Print JSON output
  --debug                      Enable debug output
  --offline                    Use the local catalog cache without refreshing
                               it first
  --command <command>          stdio executable
  --arg <arg>                  stdio argument (repeatable)
  --env <NAME=value>           stdio environment value (repeatable)
  --env-passthrough <NAME>     Pass a variable from the target daemon
                               environment (repeatable)
  --url <url>                  Streamable HTTP endpoint
  --bearer-token <token>       HTTP bearer token; supports ${VAR}
  --header <Name:value>        HTTP request header (repeatable)
  --description <description>  Server description
  --default                    Select this server by default for new sessions
  --no-default                 Do not select this server by default for new
                               sessions
  -h, --help                   display help for command

Usage: lody review [options] [command] [file]

Usage: lody session [options] [command]

Manage sessions without the web UI

Options:
  -h, --help                            display help for command

Commands:
  create [options] [prompt]             Create a new session
  chat [options] [sessionId] [prompt]   Send a new user prompt to an existing
                                        session
  cancel [options] [sessionId]          Cancel the current running turn for a
                                        session
  list [options]                        List sessions in a workspace
  history [options] [sessionId]         Read visible session transcript history
  observe [options] [sessionId]         Observe persisted Session state without
                                        executing or marking messages read
                                        (Cloud CLI)
  show [options] [sessionId]            Show session metadata
  status [options] [sessionId]          Show current session status
  rename [options] [sessionId] [title]  Rename a session
  archive [options] [sessionId]         Archive a session
  restore [options] [sessionId]         Restore an archived session
  recover-inbox [options] <sessionId>   Inspect a blocked local execution;
                                        recover only after all its resources
                                        are released
  delete [options] [sessionId]          Permanently delete an archived session
  help [command]                        display help for command

Usage: lody session chat [options] [sessionId] [prompt]

Send a new user prompt to an existing session

  --attach <path>             Attach a file from this machine; repeatable

  --prompt <text>             Prompt text
  --prompt-file <path>        Read prompt text from file, or - for stdin
  --json                      Print JSON output
  --jsonl                     Print JSON Lines output

Usage: lody session create [options] [prompt]

Create a new session

Arguments:
  prompt                           Prompt text

Options:
  --workspace <selector>           Target workspace id, slug, or name
  --machine <idOrName>             Target machine id or name
  --agent <idOrName>               Agent config id or name
  --agent-config <idOrName>        Agent config id or name
  --agent-role <idOrName>          Agent Role id or name; the Role overrides
                                   --machine, --agent(-config), --mode, --model
                                   and --config-option
  --parent <sessionId>             Parent session whose work context should be
                                   reused
  --use-current-session-as-parent  Use LODY_SESSION_ID as the parent session
  --title <title>                  Fixed session title (default: generated from
                                   the prompt)
  --repo <owner/repo>              GitHub repository to attach
  --local-project <id|name|path>   Local project id, name, or root path
  --worktree                       Create an isolated git worktree for
                                   --local-project
  --branch <name>                  Git branch to use for GitHub repos or local
                                   git projects
  --mode <modeId>                  ACP mode override
  --model <modelId>                ACP model override
  --config-option <keyValue>       ACP config option override in key=value
                                   form; repeatable (default: [])
  --env <keyValue>                 Deprecated per-session env override;
                                   configure env on the agent config instead
                                   (default: [])
  --attach <path>                  Attach a file from this machine; repeatable
                                   (default: [])
  --prompt <text>                  Prompt text
  --prompt-file <path>             Read prompt text from file, or - for stdin
  --json                           Print JSON output
  --jsonl                          Print JSON Lines output
  --wait                           Wait for the assistant turn to complete
                                   before exiting
  --timeout <seconds>              Wait timeout in seconds for --wait
  --history-backend <kind>         History backend for this session (default:
                                   loro)
  --debug                          Enable debug output
  -h, --help                       display help for command
